summary: Testing subscription cancellation handling features: entitlement endpoint, admin bypass, and dialog hideCloseButton prop. All 12 backend tests PASSED. Frontend admin login and dashboard access tested successfully.

billing_entitlement_endpoint.details: GET /api/billing/entitlement returns correct structure with is_entitled, subscription_status, cancel_at_period_end, current_period_end, active_tier, reason, server_time fields

entitlement_no_subscription_reason.details: Endpoint returns is_entitled=false with reason='no_subscription' when no subscription exists

admin_login_not_blocked.details: Admin user login works without any subscription check blocking - login returned token successfully

admin_dashboard_access.details: Admin user can access /admin dashboard - no subscription modal shown (admin bypasses entitlement check)

dialog_hideCloseButton_prop.details: dialog.jsx correctly implements hideCloseButton prop - close button is conditionally rendered only when !hideCloseButton

subscription_modal_no_close.details: SubscriptionRequiredModal uses hideCloseButton={true} to render without close button

EntitlementContext.jsx.admin_bypass: Line 31-38: Admin role check skips API call and sets is_entitled=true with reason='admin_user'

App.js_EntitlementGate.admin_bypass: Line 321-322: Admin users return children directly without entitlement check

dialog.jsx.hideCloseButton: Line 26: prop destructured, Line 37: conditional rendering with !hideCloseButton

SubscriptionRequiredModal.jsx.non_dismissible: Line 142-150: onOpenChange={() => {}}, onPointerDownOutside/onEscapeKeyDown/onInteractOutside all call e.preventDefault(), hideCloseButton={true}

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Admin login, dashboard access, no subscription modal for admin)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Subscription cancellation handling is correctly implemented: 1) Login is never blocked by Stripe status (verified backend login endpoint), 2) /api/billing/entitlement endpoint returns correct structure for checking subscription status, 3) Admin users bypass entitlement checks in both EntitlementContext.jsx and App.js EntitlementGate, 4) Dialog hideCloseButton prop works correctly, 5) SubscriptionRequiredModal uses hideCloseButton={true} and prevents all forms of dismissal
